summary: Java Backend Developer with 1+ year of professional experience in application maintenance, debugging, and REST API support, plus additional hands-on experience building full-stack applications using Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and MySQL. Skilled in database management, query optimization, and JWT-based security, with working knowledge of Docker, GitHub Actions, and AWS. Comfortable in Agile/SDLC environments with strong fundamentals in OOP, SOLID principles, and system design. Also brings entrepreneurial experience founding and operating a software/digital agency, managing client-facing technical delivery end-to-end.

highlights: Founded and run a digital agency delivering web development and digital marketing services to local businesses, managing end-to-end project delivery and client communication independently.
Performed maintenance, debugging, and issue resolution on existing Java-based applications, improving application stability.
Diagnosed and fixed backend defects across REST API endpoints and database queries, reducing recurring production issues.
Collaborated with the development team on testing, documentation, and release support using standard software development practices.
Designed and developed RESTful APIs using Spring Boot and MySQL across multiple web modules, improving backend maintainability.
Applied MVC and DAO design patterns to structure the backend, enforcing separation of concerns and enabling independent module testing.
Integrated backend services with frontend components across Agile sprints, validating API endpoints using Postman.

projects.name: QuickRide – Real-Time Cab Booking System
highlights: Built a full-stack cab booking system with REST APIs covering ride booking, driver discovery, authentication, and role-based access control.
Implemented concurrency handling using optimistic locking to prevent duplicate ride assignments under simultaneous requests.
Implemented JWT-based authentication and authorization for user and driver roles using Spring Security.
Containerized the application using Docker and set up a CI/CD pipeline via GitHub Actions.

projects.name: E-Commerce Web Application
highlights: Built a full-stack e-commerce application using Java Servlets, JDBC, and MySQL with MVC architecture.
Used connection pooling to reduce database connection overhead and improve efficiency.
Applied SQL indexing and query optimization to improve response times.
